purpose: Offline comparison of reference-only stop bearing estimates (E0 current, E1-E4) against journey-leg boarding geometry on the nov11a generation.
humanReview: None. This is a mechanical check, not human review.

definitions.E0: Current API (load_stop_facets): circular mean of stop-to-next-stop bearings over every pattern call at the stop (previous-to-stop when no call has a next stop); null when the mean unit vector is shorter than 0.8. Per pattern: stop-to-next (previous-to-stop when there is no next).
definitions.E1: Chord: per call, bearing previous stop to next stop (stop-to-next without a previous call, previous-to-stop without a next); pooled per stop by circular mean, null below 0.8.
definitions.E2: Bisector: per call, the normalised sum of the unit vectors previous-to-stop and stop-to-next (either alone when the other is missing); pooled as E1.
definitions.E3: As E2 with each unit vector weighted by 1 / (its length in metres); pooled as E1.
definitions.E4a: Arrival: per call, bearing previous-to-stop (stop-to-next when there is no previous call); pooled as E1. The mirror of E0, testing whether the street a stop is on is better told by the approach than by the departure. (E3's inverse-distance weights already equal the three-point quadratic tangent, so that is not a separate variant.)
definitions.E4b: E1 chord with the per-stop agreement threshold lowered from 0.8 to 0.5 (fewer nulls). Per pattern it equals E1.
definitions.commonRules: A neighbour call at the same stop_id (consecutive duplicate) is skipped; a neighbour less than 1 m from the stop counts as missing; a call whose own value cannot be formed contributes nothing. Implied road direction = estimate - 90 degrees (keep right: the road is to the left of the direction of travel, seen from the stop), snapped to N/E/S/W.

truths.travelBearing: boarding.bearingDegrees when bearingSource is leg_geometry (first 30 m of the leg's street path); other legs have no travel truth.
truths.roadDirection: bearing from the leg's from latitude/longitude to boarding.pathPoint when stopOffsetMeters >= the minimum, snapped to N/E/S/W.
truths.perPatternIdentification: transit.sourceTripId -> trip_profiles.profile_id -> clock_profile_calls by ordinal (source stop ids mapped through stops.source_id); boarding stop occurrence chosen whose next call is boarding.nextStop.

ceiling.rule: true travel bearing - 90, snapped, against snapped true road direction

priorRequests.note: First probe; legs had no boarding object (pre-API-BOARDS code on :8500). Not used.
Probe confirming boarding.bearingDegrees, pathPoint and stopOffsetMeters on :8520. Not used in the sample.
